about: The room, participant and storage routes leave apps/web/convex/http.ts for httpRooms.ts, the message and reaction routes for httpMessages.ts. Each file wraps its routes, one level deeper and otherwise as they stand, in a function that registers them on the router it is handed; http.ts calls the two functions where the routes stood, so the registration order is the same. The import of `internal` goes with the message routes, the only ones left that use it. Run from the repo root. Where each line landed: node scripts/step6/web-move-check.mjs scripts/step6/tables/be-http-chat-routes.ranges.json --strict-indent. Every line counted once: node scripts/step6/line-account.mjs --base 6a3496ac9e4fba09d9e4abcdd6f637bb0be1f241 --old apps/web/convex/http.ts --allow scripts/step6/tables/be-http-chat-routes.json apps/web/convex/http.ts apps/web/convex/httpRooms.ts apps/web/convex/httpMessages.ts. The base is the commit before this move (pass --base to both if it has another name); both read the tree they are run in, so they hold at the commit that made this move. apps/convex/convex is the same files byte for byte: diff -r -x _generated -x tsconfig.json apps/web/convex apps/convex/convex.
